metadata.researchMethod: Official manufacturer product pages, user manuals, technical datasheets and launch specification tables inspected through web research. Specifications are selected factual fields, not a complete compatibility guarantee. Source links do not grant image reuse rights.
metadata.pricePolicy: All prices are deliberately illustrative USD demo values, not verified retail offers. No compare-at prices, ratings or reviews are fabricated.
metadata.inventoryPolicy: Initialize each new SKU with 24 simulated units. Re-execution must preserve existing inventory, sold/reserved quantities and commerce relationships.
metadata.modelNumberPolicy: modelNumber stores the verified marketed model identity; it is not an asserted regional ordering part number. Named storage capacities, camera body-only scope, input-device switch/hand configuration and smart-home regional electrical requirements are explicit.
metadata.mediaStatus: PLANNED_ASSETS_REQUIRE_APPROVAL: deterministic local paths are the asset contract, not evidence that files exist. Additive seed must reject absent, undecodable, unreviewed or rights-unapproved media.
metadata.mediaPolicy: Each product has primary and alternate local illustrative-image references. Illustrations are not authenticated photographs and are not approved for ML/Kaggle use by this dataset. File checksums, dimensions, provenance and rights belong in the separately reviewed media manifest.
researchNotes: Canon manual specifications use maximum approximate effective pixels with RF/EF lenses. Camera listings are bodies without a kit lens.

JBL Clip 5 page has 15 hours in its numeric maximum field but explicitly explains 12 normal + 3 Playtime Boost hours; dataset retains that distinction. Other battery runtimes are manufacturer maxima and vary by use.
Samsung semiconductor model landing pages redirected to generic regional stores during research. Direct official per-model PDF datasheet URLs are retained instead.
AMD processor core/thread/clock/TDP values come from AMD tables; max boost is conditional. AM5 compatibility also requires supported motherboard firmware.

TP-Link and Tapo pages vary by country/hardware revision. Networking link rates are theoretical; smart cameras identify V1, smart plugs use the cited EU electrical specification, and bulbs use E27 220-240 V fittings.

Logitech retail pages dynamically hide some detailed specs; selected fields are grounded in visible product descriptions/features and official setup guides. Manufacturer descriptions contain occasional stale wording (K480 page mentions K400 Plus); that inconsistent sentence was not used.

Brother MFC-J4335DW and DS-640 were researched but excluded because the official pages mark them discontinued; final list uses MFC-J4355DW and ADS-1350W. No claim is made about local distributor availability.

supplementalSources.scope: Logitech MX Master 3S USB-C and thumb wheel
Tapo T110 EU radio and adhesive mounting
